hunks.sol: If even a single word about the Sword Saint slipped out with so many people watching, there would undoubtedly be an uproar.

hunks.sol: Baek Museong followed amid the cheers and countless stares, only to stop short.

hunks.sol: Baek Museong considered it for a moment, then nodded. The important conversation was between him and Jin Wikyung anyway. Better to let his junior disciples rest than have them standing beside him and yawning their heads off.
